coverage_decision: All substantive guideline chapters, all 31 formal guidance statements, all 8 main figures, all 6 main tables, and supplement Tables S1–S107 were mapped or inventoried. References were extracted separately and not atomized.
omissions: Biographic/disclosure entries were inspected as part of source structure but were not condensed person-by-person; conflict-management process is discussed at guideline-method level.

Individual rows of all 104 summary-of-findings/evidence tables are not reproduced in the SEA HTML. The supplement remains the authoritative detailed table source; key load-bearing evidence families are summarized and all table identities are inventoried.
Bibliographic entries are provenance infrastructure and were not converted to LiteratureAtoms.
Current 2026 guideline alignment was not externally verified because @VERIFY was not activated.
